coordinateFormat.description:
Source coordinate reference system of the input data, expressed as an EPSG string (e.g. `'EPSG:4326'`, `'EPSG:3395'`).

Defaults to `'EPSG:4326'` (WGS84) when omitted, which is the correct value for standards-compliant GeoJSON. Only set this when the source data deviates from RFC 7946.

geojsonObject.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection to load directly.

Per RFC 7946, GeoJSON coordinates MUST be in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) longitude/latitude. This is the default assumption when `coordinateFormat` is omitted.

If your FeatureCollection is in a different CRS (e.g. a projected system such as EPSG:3395), you MUST set `coordinateFormat` explicitly to match the actual CRS of the input data. Omitting `coordinateFormat` when the data is not in EPSG:4326 will cause the spatial transform to produce invalid geometry.

iterate.description: Iterate over every feature of `layer`. `all` runs the shader once per feature and sums the outputs. `batched` packs every feature's value into a uniform array named after this entry (matrix entries become each feature's bounding box as four corners), adds a `num_features` uniform, and runs the shader once.

path.description: Dot path from the feature root, for example `properties.height` or `geometry.coordinates.0`.

required.description: With `iterate: 'batched'`, drop features whose `path` does not resolve to a finite value.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the coordinate range of the object's Geometries, Features, or Feature Collections.
